The pencil mounts an editor pre-filled with that message.
Cancel drops the draft: the editor unmounts and the abandoned wording never reaches the thread.
Confirm on a question re-asks it: the persisted store carries only the new wording.
Editing an answer opens on the model's own text. Only reachable on a turn that is not the last one, see mock request 3.
Regenerate replays the question: the hand-written answer and everything after it leave the thread.

The cross removes the image it sits on, and what survives is what the sent message carries.
